receipt.vouchers.reprinted.description: Printed on a gift-voucher slip printed again from the voucher's page, so it can be told from the slip handed over at the sale. Printed on 58/80 mm paper.
placeholders: date the slip was reprinted

vouchers.print_slip.button.description: Button on a gift voucher's page (manager): prints that voucher's gift slip again on this till's receipt printer, without a receipt.

vouchers.print_slip.printing.description: Shown next to Print voucher slip while the slip is being sent to the receipt printer.

vouchers.print_slip.done.description: Inline confirmation after Print voucher slip on a gift voucher's page succeeded.

vouchers.print_slip.no_printer.description: Hint shown on a gift voucher's page instead of Print voucher slip when no receipt printer is set up (above a button to Settings > Receipt printer); also the inline message when the printer was removed meanwhile.

vouchers.print_slip.not_printable.description: Inline message when Print voucher slip is pressed for a voucher that was voided or used up since the page loaded.

vouchers.print_slip.original_value_note.description: Shown above Print voucher slip when the voucher's balance differs from its original value (part used, topped up or corrected): the reprinted slip prints only the original value.

shifts.close_no_sale_opens.description: Shifts page, shift-close confirmation: a second line shown under the expected/actual/variance message only when the cash drawer was opened without a sale during the closed shift. Informational; it never changes the cash figures.
placeholders: number of times the drawer was opened without a sale during the shift

reports.eod.no_sale_opens.description: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: column header, the number of drawer opens per cashier. Also used on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_title.description: Reports, End of day, archived report detail: heading of the table of cash-drawer opens without a sale. Also used as the row label (with the count) on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_total.description: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: label of the total row.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting cash-drawer opens with no sale (no money moved, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_total.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: row label before the total number of no-sale drawer opens. A longer label is cut short on paper.

settings.display.awake_hours.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle hours.
placeholders: number of hours

settings.display.awake.description: Label of the Android-only Settings > Display dropdown that sets how long the till keeps the tablet screen on without a touch.

settings.display.awake_help.description: Help line under the Android-only keep-screen-on dropdown.

settings.display.awake_minutes.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle minutes.
placeholders: number of minutes

settings.display.awake_never.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen never sleeps while the till app is open.

agent.action.settings_set.description: Title of the core-rendered confirm card when the AI assistant asks to change one or more shop settings. Nothing changes until the operator presses Confirm.

agent.field.setting.description: Column value on the assistant's confirm card for a settings change: names the row's change as a setting (the row's item is the setting's own label from the Settings screen).

agent.value.on.description: Before/after value on the assistant's confirm card for an on/off setting that is switched on.

agent.value.off.description: Before/after value on the assistant's confirm card for an on/off setting that is switched off.

promotions.customer.clear.description: Aria-label and tooltip of the x button beside the promotion's customer field; after Save any customer can use the code.

promotions.customer.deleted.description: Promotions list and dialog: the promotion is bound to a customer who no longer exists on this till (erased elsewhere). Shown instead of an id.

promotions.customer.unpicked.description: Promotion dialog error when text was typed in the customer field but no search result was chosen.

promotions.error.customer_unknown.description: Save refused in the promotion dialog: the chosen customer is not on this till (deleted or never existed).

sync.link.rejoin.description: Status-bar chip on a joined till whose connection to the main till was dropped (its data was restored onto a new device): tells the owner to join the main till again. Links to the Tills page.

sync.link.rejoin_hint.description: Tooltip of the 'join the main till again' status-bar chip: explains that the till no longer uses its old connection, that it keeps selling, and where to join again.

tills.rejoin_needed_help.description: Notice on a joined till's Tills page after its data was restored onto a new device: the steps to join the main till again, and a warning not to revoke the original till if it is still in use. 'Join an existing shop' is the label of that section on the same page.

app.name.description: The product name, shown in the window title, the header and the about page. A brand name: never translate it.

subscription.cap.order_tracking.description: Name of the paid capability customer order tracking (tracking QR on the kiosk confirmation and receipt), listed on the Subscription card and in the paused-feature banner when the shop's plan no longer includes it.

subscription.plan.local_plus.description: Name of the Local Plus subscription plan (the cheapest paid tier), shown as the shop's plan on the Subscription card and status chip. A product name: never translate it.

tills.main_unreachable_help_offline.description: Notice on a joined till's Tills page while the main till is not answering: the till keeps selling, reconnects by itself, what to check.

tills.join.rejoin_sales_warning.description: Warning above the join tabs on a till that is already joined to a main till and has sales: joining another main till replaces its data, but its unsent sales are sent there first.

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refus.description: Join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active).
placeholders: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_not_sent.description: Join error on a joined till re-joining a (new) main till: its sales that never reached a main till could not be sent there first, so the join was refused and nothing on this till changed.
placeholders: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes.description: Join error on a joined till: its day closes (Z reports) that the cloud must keep are not uploaded yet; joining would wipe them, so the join waits.
placeholders: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.main_unreachable_replaced.description: Line in the 'main till isn't answering' notice on a joined till's Tills page: what to do when the main till was replaced, and that unsent sales go to the new main till first.

tills.join.rejoin_note.description: Note in a joined till's 'join an existing shop' section: joining another main till sends its unsent sales there first.
placeholders: how many unsent sales this till has

common.back.description: Button that returns to the previous screen or step.

common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog or form without saving anything.

common.clear.description: Button that empties a field, search or selection.

common.close.description: Button that closes a panel or dialog.

common.discard_confirm.description: Confirmation question shown when the user leaves a form that has unsaved changes.

common.done.description: Button that finishes a step or closes an editing mode after the work is saved.

common.edit.description: Button or link that opens a record for editing.

common.error.invalid_upload.description: Error shown when an uploaded file can't be read or is the wrong type.

common.error.manager_or_admin_required.description: Error shown when a cashier tries an action only a manager or an admin may do.

common.error.network.description: Error shown when a request fails because the till can't reach the server or another till.

common.error.outcome_unknown.description: Error shown when the connection drops after the operator confirmed an action (manager PIN or confirm prompt) but before the till answered, so nobody knows if the action ran. Tells them to check before repeating it; there is no retry button.

common.error.outcome_timeout.description: Error shown when the till itself did not answer an action within 30 seconds (it was slow, the connection was fine), so nobody knows if the action ran. Tells them to check before repeating it; there is no retry button. Sibling of common.error.outcome_unknown, which is for a dropped connection.

common.error.server.description: Generic error shown when an action fails for an unexpected reason.

common.loading.description: Short status text shown while a list or panel is loading.

common.money.invalid.description: Validation message under an amount field when the input is not a valid amount. Keep both example amounts and both separators (dot and comma).

common.money.invalid_whole.description: Validation message under an amount field that accepts whole numbers only.

common.no_results.description: Empty-state text when a search finds nothing.

common.percent.invalid.description: Validation message under a percentage field. Keep both examples and both separators (dot and comma).

common.show_less.description: Toggle that collapses an expanded list or text.

common.show_more.description: Toggle that expands a shortened list or text.

common.view.description: Button or link that opens a record read-only.

import.file_plugin.detected.description: Shown above an import preview when an installed importer plugin recognised the uploaded export file and read it instead of the standard importer.
placeholders: the importer plugin's name

import.file_plugin.too_large.description: Error when an uploaded file is over the 32 MB an importer plugin may read; tells the user to split it.

import.file_plugin.upload_again.description: Hint under a failed import of a file an importer plugin read: the file must be chosen and previewed again.

import.file_plugin.use_standard.description: Button under an importer plugin's preview that reads the same file with the till's own standard importer instead.

import.issue.apply_failed.description: Import preview/result row detail: the row passed checks but could not be saved. Sits in a narrow table cell.

import.issue.barcode_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the same barcode is on two or more rows of this import.
placeholders: the barcode that appears on more than one row

import.issue.barcode_invalid.description: Import row detail: a barcode on the row contains characters a barcode may not have (only letters, digits and hyphens are allowed).

import.issue.barcode_not_accepted.description: Import row detail: the till's barcode settings (enabled barcode types) reject this barcode.
placeholders: the barcode the till refused

import.issue.barcode_taken.description: Import row detail: the barcode is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.
placeholders: the barcode that already belongs to another item

import.issue.category_level_invalid.description: Import row detail: one level of the row's category path is empty, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.category_too_deep.description: Import row detail: the category path has more nested levels than the till supports.
placeholders: the maximum number of category levels allowed (a number)

import.issue.description_invalid.description: Import row detail: the product description sent for this row is longer than 1000 characters or has hidden control or direction-changing characters. Line breaks are fine.

import.issue.external_id_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the other system's record ID appears on two or more rows of this import. 'ID' is the product's ID in the previous system.

import.issue.external_id_invalid.description: Import row detail: the row has no ID from the other system, or it is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.item_already_matched.description: Import row detail: an earlier row of this same import already matched the catalog item this row would update.

import.issue.item_linked_elsewhere.description: Import row detail: the catalog item that matches this row by barcode or SKU was already imported from a different record of the other system.
placeholders: the other system's record ID the item is already linked to

import.issue.name_invalid.description: Import row detail: the product name is missing, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.net_quantity_invalid.description: Import row detail: the pre-packed product's net quantity (its content: grams, millilitres or a count) is incomplete or not valid. 'g', 'ml' and 'ea' are unit codes: keep them as they are.

import.issue.price_invalid.description: Import row detail: the price is missing, negative or implausibly large.

import.issue.row_not_object.description: Import row detail: the importer sent something for this row that is not a product record.

import.issue.row_not_single_object.description: Import row detail: the importer sent more than one product record in one row.

import.issue.sku_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the same SKU (stock-keeping code) is on two or more rows of this import.

import.issue.sku_invalid.description: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.sku_taken.description: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.

import.issue.stock_out_of_range.description: Import row detail: the stock quantity is not a usable number or is implausibly large.

import.issue.too_many_barcodes.description: Import row detail: the row lists more barcodes for one product than the till allows.
placeholders: the maximum number of barcodes allowed on one item (a number)

import.issue.vat_out_of_range.description: Import row detail: the tax rate is below 0 or above 100 percent.

import.status.sku_reused_renumbered.description: Warning on an import row (Preview and result) whose item number from the old till's backup is also used by an earlier item in the same file, so this item gets a new number instead of being dropped. Sits in a narrow table cell after other status text: keep it short and lower case.
placeholders: the item number from the backup file that several items share, e.g. '30006'
the new item number this item gets instead, e.g. '30006-2'

import.system.ask_manager.description: Shown on the import page's 'From another till system' section to a user who may not install plugins or edit their settings: who to ask instead. Also shown when no importer is installed.

import.system.busy.description: Busy message while the till fetches products from the shop's previous till system through an importer plugin (can take minutes).

import.system.change.active.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product is active (sellable). One word, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.age_restricted.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product needs a staff ID (age) check before it is sold. Short, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.barcode.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's barcode. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.category.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's category. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.description.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's description text. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.name.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's name. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.net_quantity.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: a pre-packed product's net quantity (its content, e.g. 250 g). Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.price.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's selling price. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.stock.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's stock count. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.vat.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's VAT rate. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.changes.description: Import preview row detail listing which fields of an existing product the import would change. Sits in a narrow table cell: keep it short and lower case.
placeholders: comma-separated list of changed field names, e.g. 'price, stock'

import.system.col.detail.description: Column heading in the import preview table: what changes or what is wrong with the row.

import.system.col.name.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the product name.

import.system.col.result.description: Column heading in the import preview table: whether the row is new, updated, unchanged or has an issue.

import.system.col.row.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the row number from the importer.

import.system.commit_done.description: Message shown when an import from another till system has finished and the products are saved; also shown above a warning when some rows had issues.

import.system.connection.description: Accessible label read by screen readers (not visible text) for the list of an importer plugin's secret keys (API key and secret), each shown only as set or not set.

import.system.count.issues.description: Count label in an import result: rows that could not be imported because of a problem.

import.system.count.new.description: Count label in an import result: products that will be (or were) added.

import.system.count.unchanged.description: Count label in an import result: products that already match and are left as they are.

import.system.count.updated.description: Count label in an import result: existing products that will be (or were) changed.

import.system.error.bad_answer.description: Error when the importer plugin's reply can't be read; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.declined.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped and gave a reason, for example wrong API keys.
placeholders: the reason the importer plugin gave, in its own words

import.system.error.declined_silent.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped without giving a reason; points the user to the connection settings.

import.system.error.failed.description: Error when the import could not be completed for an unexpected reason; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.no_entities.description: Error when the importer plugin has not been granted permission to add products.

import.system.error.no_response.description: Error when the importer plugin did not answer in time, usually because the till is offline.

import.system.error.not_found.description: Error when the chosen importer plugin was removed while the page was open.

import.system.error.partial.description: Error when an import stopped part-way; tells the user how many products were saved and that running it again is safe.
placeholders: number of products saved before the import stopped

import.system.error.preview_failed.description: Error when the import preview could not be built.

import.system.error.refused.description: Error when the till rejected the product rows the importer plugin sent; nothing was saved.

import.system.get_importer.description: Link to the plugin store's import category, shown when no importer plugin is installed.

import.system.help.description: Explanation at the top of the 'From another till system' import section: what an importer plugin does, that preview saves nothing and that re-running is safe.

import.system.none.description: Empty state when no importer plugin for another till system is installed; says what to do next.

import.system.plugin_message.description: Shows a message the importer plugin returned, for example the name of the connected account.
placeholders: the message text the importer plugin returned

import.system.preview.description: Button that fetches products from the other till system and shows what would be imported, without saving anything.

import.system.preview_done.description: Message above the import preview: nothing is saved until the user presses Import.

import.system.run_again.description: Button that repeats an import that stopped part-way; already imported products are not duplicated.

import.system.samples.description: Heading above the table of example rows from the import preview.

import.system.settings_link.description: Link to the importer plugin's settings page, where the shop enters its API key and secret.

import.system.title.description: Heading of the import page section that imports products from another till system through an installed importer plugin.

import.welcome.system.action.description: Button on the import page's welcome card that opens the 'From another till system' section.

import.welcome.system.body.description: Text on the import page's welcome card explaining importing straight from the shop's old till system account, with a preview first.

import.welcome.system.title.description: Title of the import page's welcome card for importing from another till system.

plugins.settings.error.choice.description: Error under a plugin settings dropdown when the saved choice is not one of its options. Shown in red under the field; nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.error.max.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the value is above the plugin's allowed maximum. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the largest allowed value, already formatted for the shop (a number, a percentage such as 50.00% or an amount with its currency such as £100.00)

plugins.settings.error.min.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the value is below the plugin's allowed minimum. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the smallest allowed value, already formatted for the shop (a number, a percentage such as 5.00% or an amount with its currency such as £1.00)

plugins.settings.error.number.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the typed text is not a number in the accepted format (a whole number, or a decimal with a dot or comma for a percentage or amount). Nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.error.required.description: Error under a plugin settings field the plugin marks as required, when it was left empty. Nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.error.stored_invalid.description: Note under a plugin settings field whose already-saved value doesn't fit the field (for example the plugin changed the field from text to a number). The value is shown as it is and is not changed unless the user edits it.

plugins.settings.error.summary.description: Message next to the Save button of a plugin's settings when the save was refused because one or more fields are invalid; each bad field shows its own error.

plugins.settings.error.too_long.description: Error under a plugin settings text field when the text is longer than the plugin allows. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the maximum number of characters allowed (a number)

plugins.settings.error.url.description: Error under a plugin settings web-address field when the value isn't an http or https address. Keep http://, https:// and the example address unchanged. Nothing was saved.

pos.scan_choice.customer.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a customer or loyalty card. The customer's name is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.item.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a catalog item (product). The item's name and price are shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.promo.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a promotion or discount code. The code is shown under it.

basket.discount_too_large.description: Sale screen basket: shown under a line's discount box when the cashier enters a discount (or lowers the quantity) so the discount would be more than the line's total. The change is not applied.
placeholders: the line's total, the most the discount can be (an amount of money with currency)

pos.toast.line_discount_too_large.description: Sale screen error toast: the sale was not completed because one basket line still has a discount larger than its line total. Nothing was charged; the cashier lowers that line's discount.
placeholders: the name of the item on that basket line

pos.error.void_voucher_additional_till.description: Error when a manager voids a sale on an additional till and the sale sold or topped up a gift voucher. The void is refused and nothing changes.

pos.scan_choice.receipt.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is the number of an earlier receipt (sale), which opens its refund. The receipt number is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.title.description: Heading of the sale-screen chooser shown when one scanned or typed code matches more than one thing (e.g. an item and a gift voucher). It asks the cashier which one they meant.

pos.scan_choice.voucher.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a gift voucher number. The voucher number and remaining balance are shown under it.

reports.days.last_24h.description: Reports page, Custom range: the option in the 'number of days' dropdown that shows the rolling last 24 hours up to now (not the business day, which is the Today chip). Sits in a narrow select.

reports.zpaper.articles_more.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the top items when the list is cut short; the full list is on the screen.
placeholders: how many more items are not printed (a number)

reports.zpaper.by_article.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_article_group.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item category. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_department.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per department (top-level category). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_operator.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per cashier. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_order_type.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales split into eat-in and takeaway. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_till.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per till (register). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cash.calculated.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the cash the drawer should hold. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.cash_sales.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken for sales. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.new_float.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash left in the drawer for the next shift. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.opening_float.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash in the drawer when the shift opened. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_ins.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash put into the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_outs.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken out of the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.tips_held_out.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash tips kept apart from the shop's takings. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the cash drawer count against the expected cash. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cleared_baskets.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: shopping baskets the cashier cleared with New sale before taking payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before the baskets' total amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.
placeholders: the number of cleared baskets

reports.zpaper.cleared_title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting shopping baskets cleared with New sale before payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.end_of_day.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the period line of an older day-based report.
placeholders: the business day, as YYYY-MM-DD

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.match.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count matches the till's.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.mismatch.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count differs from the till's.
placeholders: the device's receipt count (a number)
the till's payment count on the device (a number)

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.no_activity.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device recorded nothing and the till sent nothing to it in this period.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.other.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: count of other fiscal device slips. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.serial.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's serial number (row label).

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.till_tender.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: how many payments the till sent to the fiscal device (ÖKC). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the Turkish fiscal device (ÖKC) check. Keep 'OKC'/'ÖKC' as it is. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_closed_mi.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the device's Z numbers when it closed its own day inside this period. At most 30 characters with the numbers left out, so the Z numbers still fit the 42-column paper.
placeholders: the device's Z report numbers, comma-separated

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_no.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's own Z report number(s) (row label). 'Z' stays as it is.

reports.zpaper.receipts_range.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the first and last receipt numbers in this period.
placeholders: the first receipt number
the last receipt number

settings.staff_links.help.description: Muted line under the 'Users and permissions' card in Settings → Staff & security, introducing the links to the Users and Permissions pages.

settings.staff_links.title.description: Heading of the card in Settings → Staff & security that links to the Users page (staff accounts and PINs) and the Permissions page; also its entry in the settings sidebar.

settings.enrol.pair_help_2.description: Explanation under the Pair with a shop heading in Settings → Till registration. The two quoted names are the exact button labels on my.universaltill.com (Pair a till / Pair again); translators should use the my. translations of those labels.

settings.enrol.terms.accepted.description: Muted line in Settings and the setup wizard once the operator has accepted the current cloud service terms. 1st placeholder: the terms version (e.g. v0.1-draft, keep as is); 2nd: the date accepted (YYYY-MM-DD).

elevation.summary.reduce_line_qty.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier lowers a priced basket line's quantity (the minus button, the quantity box, or zero): it names the item, the old and new quantity and the void/comp/waste reason the approver is allowing.

current quantity

elevation.summary.enrol_terms.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier presses Accept terms (or Send to the cloud) under Settings → Till registration for an already registered till: it names the action the approver is allowing.

settings.enrol.terms.accept_btn.description: Button under Settings → Till registration (already registered till, cloud terms not yet accepted) that records the ticked acceptance of the cloud service terms and sends it to the cloud.

settings.enrol.terms.send_btn.description: Button under Settings → Till registration, shown when the cloud service terms are accepted on this till but the acceptance has not reached the cloud yet; it sends it again.

settings.enrol.terms.unsent.description: Muted note under Settings → Till registration: the cloud service terms were accepted on this till, but the acceptance has not yet been delivered to the cloud (for example the till was offline).

settings.enrol.terms.accept_required.description: Error shown when the operator presses Accept terms on an already registered till without ticking the cloud service terms checkbox; nothing was recorded or sent.

settings.language.download_group.description: Label of the group in Settings → Language's language list holding languages not installed yet, which download from the plugin catalog when picked.

settings.language.downloads_on_select.description: Note under Settings → Language: a language from the download group installs in the background when applied, and the till switches to it once it has arrived.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_confir.description: Label of a required tick box in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales. translations.mode.title.description: Name of the manager-only view mode that shows each on-screen text's translation key. Card title on the translation editor and label in the status bar.

translations.mode.refused_kiosk.description: Error when someone tries to turn on translate mode on a till set up as a customer self-order kiosk.

translations.mode.unknown_key.description: Message in the translate-mode panel when the pressed text's key is not known to the till.

translations.mode.panel_title.description: Title of the side panel that opens when a manager Alt+clicks or long-presses a text in translate mode.

translations.mode.other_keys.description: Lead-in above a list of text keys, when the pressed element shows several texts (for example a label and its tooltip).

translations.mode.no_description.description: Shown in the translate-mode panel when the text has no translator note yet.

translations.mode.english.description: Label for the English source text, shown under the current language's text when they differ.

translations.mode.weblate_title.description: Heading of the panel section that links the text to the shared translation service (Weblate).

translations.mode.qr_alt.description: Screen-reader description of the QR code image. Weblate is a product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.qr_hint.description: Hint under the QR code: scanning it opens the same link on a phone or another computer.

translations.mode.plugin_key.description: Shown instead of the Weblate link when the text belongs to an installed plugin rather than the till itself.

translations.mode.override_title.description: Heading of the panel section where a manager changes the wording on this till only (the same overrides as the translation editor).

translations.mode.override_help.description: Explanation under the Shop override heading. 'Reset' refers to the Reset button (translations.reset).

translations.mode.saved.description: Confirmation after a shop override is saved from the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.empty.description: Error when Save is pressed with an empty override field.

translations.mode.reload.description: Button that reloads the page so a saved override shows.

translations.mode.page_areas.description: Heading of the list of areas (groups in the translation service) that the texts on the current page belong to.

translations.mode.page_areas_help.description: Explanation under 'Areas on this page': these are the translation-service groups to invite a translator to.

settings.tills.main_till_addr.description: Line on a joined till's Settings Tills card giving the network address of the main till it follows.

channel_orders.detail.refunded_total.description: Label: total amount refunded so far.

channel_orders.detail.actions_note.description: Note under an online order: where status actions are taken. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

channel_orders.error.load_failed.description: Error shown when the Online orders list or an order cannot be read.

channel_orders.error.not_found.description: Error shown when an order id is unknown.

desktop.startup_failed.title.description: Heading of the window the desktop app shows when the till program stopped right after it was opened.

desktop.startup_failed.body.description: Paragraph under the heading explaining that the till program stopped right after opening.

desktop.startup_failed.step_retry.description: First step in the numbered list: close the window and open the app again.

desktop.startup_failed.step_reinstall.description: Second step in the numbered list: reinstall from the latest installer; saved data is kept. Keep the product name unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.logs.description: Sentence introducing the data folder path, asking the user to send the two log files from it to support. File names desktop.log and till.log stay unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.detail.description: Label before the technical reason (for example an exit status) shown in small text for support.

settings.backup.restore_refused.description: Notice in Settings → Backups after the till refused, at restart, a staged restore whose file was not a usable till database. Shown until the next restore is staged.

settings.backup.save_failed_space.description: Backups list message when the copy could not be saved because the destination is full.

settings.backup.save_failed_permission.description: Backups list message when the till may not write to the destination folder.

settings.backup.save_failed_unreachable.description: Backups list message when the destination folder (for example a USB drive) cannot be reached.

settings.backup.save_failed_use_picker.description: Backups list message on Android when a direct save is refused because the app saves through its file picker.

settings.backup.picker_saved.description: Backups list message after the Android file picker saved the backup copy.

settings.backup.picker_cancelled.description: Backups list message when the operator closed the Android file picker without choosing a place.

settings.backup.picker_failed.description: Backups list message when writing the backup to the place chosen in the Android file picker failed.

settings.backup.picker_no_space.description: Backups list message when the place chosen in the Android file picker is full.

settings.backup.safety_failed.description: Error in Settings → Backups when the till could not snapshot the current data before a restore, so the restore was not staged.

settings.backup.delete.description: Button on a row of the backups list that deletes that backup file.

settings.backup.delete_confirm.description: Question asked before a backup file is deleted from the backups list.

settings.backup.delete_failed.description: Error when deleting a backup file failed.

settings.backup.delete_invalid.description: Error when the name sent to delete is not a backup file.

settings.backup.delete_missing.description: Error when the backup to delete is already gone.

settings.backup.delete_newest.description: Error when someone tries to delete the newest backup, which is always kept.

settings.backup.deleted.description: Confirmation shown after a backup file was deleted.

settings.backup.newest_kept.description: Label on the newest backup row, which has no Delete button because it is always kept.

settings.backup.retention_days.description: Label of the number field: how many days of backups the till keeps.

settings.backup.retention_failed.description: Error when the backup days setting could not be saved.

settings.backup.retention_hint.description: Help under the backup days field: older backups are deleted automatically when the next one is made; the newest is always kept.

settings.backup.retention_invalid.description: Error for a backup days value that is not a whole number in range.
placeholders: the largest allowed number of days

settings.backup.retention_save.description: Button that saves the backup days setting.

settings.backup.retention_saved.description: Confirmation shown after the backup days setting was saved.

settings.backup.upload.title.description: Heading of the part of Settings → Backups where a manager uploads a backup file (for example from a USB stick) to restore it.

settings.backup.upload.help.description: Help line under 'Restore from a file'. The file name pattern unitill-pos-….db stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.label.description: Label of the file picker for the backup file to restore.

settings.backup.upload.action.description: Button that uploads the chosen backup file so the till can check it. Nothing is restored yet.

settings.backup.upload.checking.description: Shown while the backup file uploads and is checked (can take a while for a large file).

settings.backup.upload.shop.description: Line in the checked-backup summary naming the shop the backup belongs to.
placeholders: the shop name stored in the backup

settings.backup.upload.sales.description: Line in the checked-backup summary: how many sales the backup holds.
placeholders: the number of sales

settings.backup.upload.newest_sale.description: Line in the checked-backup summary: the date and time of the newest sale in the backup, the cut-off of what a restore brings back.
placeholders: the date and time of the newest sale

settings.backup.upload.no_sales.description: Line in the checked-backup summary when the backup holds no sales.

settings.backup.upload.replaces.description: Warning above the Restore button for an uploaded backup.

settings.backup.upload.live_sales.description: Extra warning above the Restore button when this till has already rung up sales.

settings.backup.upload.restore.description: Button that restores the uploaded, checked backup (asks for the manager PIN next).

settings.backup.upload.error.not_backup.description: Error when the uploaded file is not a till database or fails the integrity check. Product name and file pattern stay unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.error.newer.description: Error when the uploaded backup's database schema is newer than this till's build.

settings.backup.upload.error.other_shop.description: Error when the uploaded backup names a different my. shop than the one this till is paired with.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_space.description: Error when the disk is already below the low-disk floor, so no upload is accepted.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_file.description: Error when the form was sent without a file.

settings.backup.upload.error.failed.description: Generic error when checking an uploaded backup failed for a reason on the till's side.

import.welcome.restore.body.description: Line under the ways to start on the welcome page after setup, for a new device replacing a broken till.

import.welcome.restore.action.description: Button on the welcome page that opens Settings → Backups → Restore from a file.

settings.backup.upload.ready.description: Shown after an uploaded backup passed every check; the file name follows on the same line. Product name stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.error.too_old.description: Error when the uploaded backup comes from a version before the database schema reset, which this build cannot open.

settings.backup.upload.error.too_large.description: Error when the uploaded file is over the size cap (a fixed maximum, or less when the disk is fuller).
placeholders: the largest file size allowed, for example 1.5 GB

status.backup_copy.label.description: Status-bar chip for managers: no backup was downloaded or saved off this till in the last 7 days. Links to Settings → Backups.

status.backup_copy.hint.description: Tooltip of the no-backup-copied chip: why and how to copy a backup off the till.

tills.sales_mirror.title.description: Heading of the Tills page card for the read-only copy of the shop's sales kept on every additional till (ut-docs#5074).

tills.sales_mirror.help.description: Explanation under the sales-copy card heading on the Tills page.

tills.sales_mirror.status_on.description: State of the shop-wide sales copy on the main till: switched on.

tills.sales_mirror.status_off.description: State of the shop-wide sales copy on the main till: switched off (the default).

tills.sales_mirror.window.description: How long each additional till keeps copied sales.
placeholders: number of days

tills.sales_mirror.till_waiting.description: Line per additional till on the main till: that till has not fetched its copy yet.
placeholders: till name

tills.sales_mirror.till_catching_up.description: Line per additional till on the main till: how many changes its copy is behind.
placeholders: till name
number of changes

tills.sales_mirror.till_up_to_date.description: Line per additional till on the main till: its copy is current.
placeholders: till name

tills.sales_mirror.turn_on.description: Button on the main till that switches the shop's sales copy on.

tills.sales_mirror.turn_off.description: Button on the main till that switches the shop's sales copy off (copies are kept).

tills.sales_mirror.copy_behind.description: On an additional till: how many changes its copy is behind the main till.
placeholders: number of changes

tills.sales_mirror.copy_summary.description: On an additional till: how many sales its copy holds and the oldest day (YYYY-MM-DD).
placeholders: number of copied sales
oldest copied day

tills.sales_mirror.copy_empty.description: On an additional till with the copy on: nothing copied yet.

tills.sales_mirror.state.up_to_date.description: State of this additional till's copy: current.

tills.sales_mirror.state.off.description: State of this additional till's copy: the shop has the copy switched off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.off_here.description: State of this additional till's copy: this till's own switch is off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.paused_low_disk.description: State of this additional till's copy: paused because the disk is nearly full (only the last 31 days are kept).

tills.sales_mirror.state.paused_budget.description: State of this additional till's copy: paused at its disk budget.

tills.sales_mirror.state.needs_update.description: State of this additional till's copy: the main till runs a newer copy format; update this till.

tills.sales_mirror.state.needs_tls.description: State of this additional till's copy: it has no secure (pinned TLS) link to the main till yet.

tills.sales_mirror.state.main_off.description: State of this additional till's copy: the main till has the copy switched off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.satellite.description: State on a satellite till: satellites keep no copy of the shop's sales.

tills.sales_mirror.state.catching_up.description: State of this additional till's copy: it is fetching changes or re-syncing; the count of changes to go follows.

tills.promote_adopted.description: Promote result on a till that kept a copy of the shop's sales: how many copied sales became its own record.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_failed.description: Promote result: some copied sales could not be added to this till's record (a receipt number or reference it refuses); they stay in the copy.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_voided.description: Promote result: sales this till held as completed that the copy knew were voided, now voided here too.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_resumes.description: Promote result: adopting the copy stopped (an error); nothing is lost and it resumes on its own.

tills.promote_outside_z.description: Promote warning: sales from before the previous main till's last close that never reached it in time, so they may be in no Z report.
placeholders: number of sales

sync.quarantine_reason.single_purpose_vo.description: Reason column on /sync-quarantine: a journaled top-up of a single-purpose voucher (VAT fixed at issue) from an additional till was refused, so the entry is quarantined.

categories.item_count_plural.description: Count of active catalog items in a category, shown in the category list and the menu designer ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

products.category_button_count_plural.description: Count of quick buttons on the sale screen for a category, shown in the category tile overflow and the menu designer ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

plugins.install.error.pair_required.description: Error shown when installing a paid plugin from a till that is not paired with its shop: tells the owner to pair the till first. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.pair_again.description: Error shown when the marketplace rejects this till's credential (expired, replaced or mismatched): tells the owner to pair the till with the shop again. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.till_removed.description: Error shown when the shop has removed, replaced or moved this till so it can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to pair it with the shop again. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.till_replaced.description: Error shown when another till in the shop replaced this one so it can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to install plugins on the till that replaced it.

plugins.install.error.till_moved.description: Error shown when this till was moved to another shop so its old shop connection can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to connect it to its new shop under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.register_new.description: Error shown when the cloud rejects this till's credential and its store has no owner yet: tells the owner to register the till as a new store under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.service_unavailabl.description: Error shown when the marketplace refuses plugin downloads for this shop because its country is not served.

agent.action.catalog_item_update.description: Title of the confirm card when the AI assistant proposes changing existing items' name, price, category or barcode.

agent.field.name.description: Row label on the AI confirm card for an item's name change.

agent.field.category.description: Row label on the AI confirm card for an item's category change.

agent.items.no_photo.description: Screen-reader label for the empty thumbnail of an item that has no photo in the AI assistant's item list.

agent.items.open_catalog.description: Button under the AI assistant's item list that opens the catalog showing the same items.

catalog.missing.barcode.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a barcode (opened from an AI assistant answer).

catalog.missing.image.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a photo.

catalog.missing.price.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items with no price (zero).

catalog.missing.category.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a category.

catalog.missing.several.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items missing any of barcode, photo, price or category.

catalog.missing.clear.description: Link in the filter banner that returns to the full catalog list.

page.title.move_till.description: Browser tab title of the page where a manager approves or declines moving this till into another shop.

settings.move.title.description: Heading of the page where a manager or admin approves or declines moving this till (with its history) into another shop's cloud account.

settings.move.from.description: Label before the name of the shop this till belongs to now, on the move approval page.

settings.move.into.description: Label before the name of the shop the till would move into, on the move approval page.

settings.move.expires.description: Label before the date and time after which the move request expires and nothing moves.

settings.move.warning.description: Plain warning on the move approval page: what approving does (all history goes to the other account) and an anti-scam line. No compliance claims.

settings.move.who.description: Line under the warning: who decides (manager/admin PIN) and that selling continues meanwhile.

settings.move.type_name.description: Label of the text field where the approver types the target shop's name (shown right after the label) before Approve works.

settings.move.approve.description: Primary button: approve moving this till into the other shop (asks for a PIN next).

settings.move.decline.description: Secondary button: decline the move (asks for a PIN next). Nothing moves.

settings.move.offline.description: Shown when the cloud is out of reach: the decision cannot be sent; nothing is queued.

settings.move.gone.description: Shown on the move page when the move is unknown or already ended.

settings.move.name_mismatch.description: Error when the typed target shop name does not match; nothing was sent and no PIN was asked.

settings.move.summary_approve.description: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (approve a move).

settings.move.summary_decline.description: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (decline a move).

placeholders: the name of the shop the till moved into

settings.move.declined.description: After a declined move (or one already declined).

settings.move.locked.description: After 3 wrong PINs on one move: it is declined automatically.

settings.move.result_expired.description: The cloud says the move expired.

settings.move.result_cancelled.description: The target shop's owner cancelled the move on my.

settings.move.result_done.description: The cloud says the move already happened.

settings.move.result_failed.description: The cloud refused the move after approval (state changed) or moves are switched off.

settings.move.result_quarantined.description: The till's approval key was reported recently and is in its waiting period.
placeholders: the date and time from which the till can approve

settings.move.result_key.description: Approval key conflict, missing or unusable on the till.

settings.move.result_invalid.description: Signature or credential refused by the cloud.

settings.move.result_error.description: Any other failure sending the decision.

settings.move.notice_pending.description: Banner for managers/admins when a move waits for this till's approval.
placeholders: the name of the shop asking to take the till
the date and time the request expires

settings.move.notice_review.description: Link in the move banner (and after pairing) that opens the approval page.

settings.move.notice_cancelled.description: Banner after the target owner cancelled a pending move.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_expired.description: Banner after a pending move expired.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_locked.description: Banner after a move was declined automatically for wrong PINs.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.pending_msg.description: After Pair: the cloud recorded the move; it waits for approval on this till.

settings.move.confirm_title.description: Heading of the confirmation after pressing Pair on a till that belongs to a shop, where pairing asks to move it.

settings.move.confirm_body.description: Body of that confirmation. Keep both placeholders; the till wraps each in bidi isolates.
placeholders: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set
the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted (keep as is)

settings.move.confirm_btn.description: Primary button of that confirmation: send the code and ask for the move.

settings.move.source_lost.description: Pair refused on the till: its old shop credential is dead and it has history; nothing changed.

settings.move.refused.description: Generic refusal of a move request (wrong code, server error...).

settings.move.refused_needs_owner.description: Move refused: the code was made by a member, not the owner.

settings.move.refused_other_owner.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a different owner.

settings.move.refused_shop_has_tills.description: Move refused: the till's current shop has other tills.

settings.move.refused_fiscal_device.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a fiscal device (e.g. TSE). No compliance claims.

settings.move.refused_paid_licence.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a paid/granted plan.

settings.move.refused_target_unavailable.description: Move refused: the target shop already has a main till, is merging, or is unavailable.

settings.move.refused_source_unavailable.description: Move refused: the till's current shop is unavailable (deleted or merging).

settings.move.refused_pending.description: Move refused: another move is already pending for this till.

settings.move.refused_declined_recently.description: Move refused: a recent decline blocks this requester for a day.

promotions.col.dates.description: Column header on the Promotions list: the promotion's start and end dates, shown as two stacked lines in one column. An open side shows a dash.

promotions.deactivate_confirm.description: Confirmation shown before a promotion is deactivated from its edit dialog: says it stops working at checkout and can be reactivated.

promotions.edit_title.description: Title of the Promotions record dialog when an existing promotion is opened for editing.

promotions.empty.description: Empty state on the Promotions page when no promotion exists yet; points at the + button next to the search field.

promotions.search_placeholder.description: Label and placeholder of the search field above the Promotions list (filters rows by code, description or customer).

kitchenstations.search_placeholder.description: Label and placeholder of the search field above the Kitchen stations list (filters rows by name, destination or printer address).

kitchenstations.edit.description: Title of the Kitchen stations record dialog when an existing station is opened for editing.

kitchenstations.empty.description: Empty state on the Kitchen stations page when no station exists yet; points at the + button and says where tickets go meanwhile.

kitchenstations.deactivate_confirm.description: Confirmation shown before a station is deactivated from its dialog; says orders stop and station-only routes fall back to the default kitchen printer.

kitchenstations.discover.used.description: Confirmation shown under Find printers after the operator taps Use this address on a discovered printer; the address field is filled but not yet saved.

notices.title.description: Heading of the Notices inbox page, listing messages from Universal Till and from partners.

notices.nav.description: Label of the bell in the left rail (and the Notices row of the phone menu) that opens the Notices inbox.

notices.nav.unread.description: Accessible name of the bell when something is unread: the label plus how many notices are unread.
placeholders: how many notices are unread

notices.drawer.open_unread.description: Accessible name of the phone top bar menu button while notices are unread: the menu label plus how many are unread.
placeholders: how many notices are unread

notices.tab.unread.description: Inbox tab showing only notices not yet opened or dismissed.

notices.tab.all.description: Inbox tab showing every notice currently held, read or not.

notices.sev.info.description: Severity word on a notice: plain information, shown in the inbox only.

notices.sev.important.description: Severity word on a notice that also pops up once on the sale screen.

notices.sev.critical.description: Severity word on a notice from Universal Till that stays as a strip on every screen until a manager acknowledges it.

notices.sender.platform.description: Sender shown on a notice sent by Universal Till itself. A brand name: never translate it.

notices.sender.partner.description: Sender line on a notice sent by a partner of the shop; the partner name comes from the server.
placeholders: the partner's name

notices.sender.sr.description: Screen-reader-only word placed before the sender of a notice.

notices.unread.sr.description: Screen-reader-only word placed before the title of an unread notice.

notices.expires.description: Expiry line of a notice in the inbox; the date follows in the shop's date format.
placeholders: the date the notice stops showing

notices.open.description: Button or link that opens a notice in full, or follows the action link it carries.

notices.dismiss.description: Button that hides a notice from the Unread tab; it stays in All until it expires.

notices.dismiss.aria.description: Accessible name of the close button on a pop-up notice, naming the notice.
placeholders: the notice title

notices.empty.title.description: Heading of the empty Notices inbox.

notices.empty.body.description: Sentence under the empty-inbox heading: says what appears here and that selling is not affected.

notices.critical.ack.description: Button on a critical notice that a manager or admin presses to say they have seen it; it removes the strip.

notices.critical.cashier.description: Second line of the critical strip for a cashier, who cannot acknowledge it: a manager has been told and selling continues.

page.title.notices.description: Browser tab title of the Notices inbox page.

permissions.action.notices.view.description: Name of the permission that lets a role see the Notices bell and inbox, and mark notices read or acknowledged.

permissions.action_desc.notices.view.description: One-line description of the Notices permission on the Permissions page.

settings.notices.title.description: Heading of the Settings card that switches Notices on or off for this till.

settings.notices.help.description: Help text of the Notices settings card: what it shows, that a notice never blocks a sale, off by default, and that turning it off removes held notices.

settings.notices.enable.description: Checkbox label that switches Notices on for this till.

settings.notices.save.description: Save button of the Notices settings card.

settings.printer.voucher_slip.description: Checkbox label in Settings > Receipt printer: when ticked, every gift voucher sold or topped up in a sale also prints on its own separate slip after the receipt.

settings.printer.voucher_slip_hint.description: Help line under the separate-gift-voucher-slip checkbox in Settings > Receipt printer: when it prints, what is on the slip (a top-up's slip adds the amount added and the new balance), and that voided vouchers and top-ups taken back get none.
